top_signal.title: I run a gaming news project, but I'm struggling to manage everything. Any advice?
top_signal.summary: Hello everyone!   I'm looking for some advice about my gaming news project, Gamerushnews.   I started this project in April 2026, mainly focusing on social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. I've been working on it for about seven months now, and so far, I've managed to build a small but growing audience: 1,494 followers on TikTok, 440 on Instagram, and 42 on YouTube.   Around two months ago, I also started publishing articles on Substack. On top of that, I manage another project called Gamerushdeals, where I share deals and discounts related to the gaming industry, also across social media.   However, lately, managing everything has become increasingly difficult. Between university, other personal commitments, and the time required to create content for both projects, I'm finding it harder and harder to keep everything running smoothly.   That's why I'd really appreciate some advice from people who have experience in this field.   Here are some of the things I'd love to get your thoughts on:   -How can I better organize and manage multiple projects like these without getting overwhelmed?   -How do you find people who might be interested in joining a project in its early stages?   -Is it better to keep working alone for now and focus on growing the project, or should I start looking for collaborators?   What would you recommend doing to turn a small social media project into something bigger in the future?   I honestly have so many questions, and I'm stil
